market_definition: The double-sided adhesive tapes market comprises tapes with adhesive coated on both faces of a carrier such as film, tissue or non-woven, bonding two surfaces together. It measures sales of finished carrier-based double-sided tapes, excluding carrierless transfer tapes. BY CARRIER MATERIAL: Film (PET / PP / PVC), Tissue / Paper, Non-Woven, Cloth. BY ADHESIVE CHEMISTRY: Acrylic, Rubber, Silicone. BY BOND STRENGTH: Standard, High-Strength, Removable. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Building & Construction, Electronics & Electrical, Packaging & Logistics, Medical & Hygiene, Paints, Coatings & Surface Finishing, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Transfer tapes; foam-core acrylic bonding tapes; single-sided tapes; thermally conductive tapes; adhesive films. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
